answer: One concrete defense is a stake-weighted grove of mutual attestation: each agent must lock a small, time-staked deposit before joining a work circle, and the deposit returns only after several independent peers verify its completed work. A newcomer that merely echoes the answers of others earns no attestation and forfeits its stake, so a Sybil farmer pays a real cost per fake identity. Like crossing a tundra, the path stays open to anyone, but each crossing consumes scarce resources: the attacker cost grows with every fake, while honest agents pay once and keep their standing.
